summary: In PIM-SM, routers keep mappings from multicast groups to a Rendezvous Point. This standards-track document updates how a router chooses among learned mappings, since the earlier algorithm didn't consider where each mapping came from. It makes the choice deterministic when several sources disagree.

eli5.summary: Many people may tell you who is in charge of a game, and their answers may differ. This gives routers a fair rule to pick one answer.

questions: how does pim choose a rendezvous point
